body.zh: 余凯公开预测自动驾驶时间表：2028年脱手开，2030年闭眼开，2035年可以睡觉开。

title.zh: 地平线余凯：下个改变世界的计算终端是机器人

body.en: Kai Yu argued the next world-changing computing terminal will be the robot, positioning Horizon's roadmap around embodied AI.
body.zh: 余凯提出下一个改变世界的计算终端将是机器人,为地平线布局具身智能定调。

title.en: 智驾体验已过拐点？业内激辩AI颠覆汽车业路径，地平线余凯：高端智驾配置三年内将成主流标配

body.en: Yu predicted that high-end autonomous-driving configurations will become the mainstream standard within three years, at an industry forum on AI's disruption of the auto sector.
body.zh: 余凯在一场探讨AI颠覆汽车行业的业内论坛上预测，高端智能驾驶配置将在三年内成为主流标配。

title.zh: 地平线余凯：星空芯片可以让车厂用同样多的内存，多造一倍的车

body.en: Yu Kai said Horizon's Xingkong (Starlight) chip lets automakers build twice as many cars with the same memory budget, a concrete efficiency claim for its automotive silicon.
body.zh: 余凯表示，地平线的星空芯片可以让车厂用相同的内存造出双倍数量的汽车，这是对其车规级芯片效率的具体量化表述。

body.en: Horizon Robotics launched a new cockpit-driving fusion chip, which Kai Yu is positioning as China's answer to Tesla's FSD and xAI's Grok.
body.zh: 地平线机器人发布新款舱驾融合芯片，余凯将其定位为中国版特斯拉FSD与xAI Grok的对标产品。

title.zh: 智能电动2026 | 余凯：地平线将发中国首款舱驾融合芯片“星空”，单车降本1500-4000元

body.en: Yu announced Horizon Robotics' upcoming 'Xingkong' chip, China's first cockpit-and-driving fused automotive chip, projected to cut per-vehicle cost by 1,500-4,000 yuan — a concrete product launch for the company's core silicon line.
body.zh: 余凯宣布地平线即将推出“星空”芯片，这是中国首款舱驾融合汽车芯片，预计可为单车降低成本1500至4000元——是公司核心芯片产品线的一次具体发布。

title.zh: 地平线创始人兼CEO余凯：L2市占近50%，2026年发布首款舱驾融合智能体芯片

body.en: Yu says Horizon Robotics now holds nearly 50% share in the L2 driver-assist market and will launch its first cockpit-driving fused agentic chip in 2026.
body.zh: 余凯表示地平线在L2市场份额已接近50%，并将于2026年推出首款舱驾融合智能体芯片。

body.en: Kai Yu publicly distanced Horizon Robotics from an employee's comments seen as disparaging XPeng, stating they did not represent the company.
body.zh: 针对疑似地平线员工内涵小鹏一事，余凯亲自表态与该言论"割席"，称其不代表公司官方立场。

title.zh: 余凯：3年将实现脱手开、5年实现闭眼开

body.en: Kai Yu predicts Horizon-equipped vehicles will reach hands-free driving within 3 years and eyes-closed autonomy within 5, a concrete public timeline for the company's self-driving roadmap.
body.zh: 余凯预测搭载地平线方案的车辆将在3年内实现脱手驾驶、5年内实现闭眼驾驶，为公司自动驾驶路线图给出具体时间表。
